Tier Novice

Trigger the named complication occurs

Effect the prepared response resolves automatically with a +1 circumstance bonus, costing you no action in the moment

Name one specific thing that might go wrong before a job and have a minor prepared response ready.

cinderfall.incomplete: The bonus is self-facing, but "the prepared response" has no fixed selector -- it's whatever check the player names fresh each use, so no stable selector string can be written.
